symptom: `marketplace install` of Excel Importer 11.2.2 moved Datagrid and its filters to 3.8.1 while the Data Widgets module and its styling stayed at 3.5.0; every Data grid 2 collapsed into one column, with no error.
cause: InstallPackageFiles only refused a bundled widget OLDER than the project's copy (the rollback guard). Excel Importer bundles Datagrid, DatagridDropdownFilter, DatagridNumberFilter and DatagridTextFilter at 3.8.1 but not themesource/datawidgets, which ships only in the Data Widgets module (with nine widgets) — so the widgets moved and their CSS did not.
fix: A bundled copy of a widget a styling module styles is not installed past that module's version in the project, unless the package is that module; the skip is reported under its own heading with the update to run (SkippedFile.StyledBy).
insight: List the package before reasoning about it: `unzip -l` on Excel Importer and Data Widgets showed which widgets travel without their styling in a minute. Live on 11.12.6 with the real packages: the four Data Widgets widgets stay at the project's version, Combobox and Image follow the old rules, and mx check reports no widget error (the remaining errors are Excel Importer's MxModelReflection dependency).
